record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.original_question: For a general Sobolev orthogonality setting with two measures, determine the asymptotic behavior of the orthogonal polynomials when the supports of the measures do not coincide: in particular, when the supports are disjoint, or when they overlap but neither support contains the other. The known case is when the second measure is supported on the same compact set as the first; the unresolved task is to handle the non-nested or non-overlapping support cases where the algebraic relations available for the discrete Sobolev product are absent.

artifact.status_search_result: The asymptotic theory of Sobolev orthogonal polynomials is well developed for coherent pairs and for cases where the second measure's support is contained in the first. Existing literature (e.g., works on non-coherent Jacobi–Sobolev and Gegenbauer–Sobolev pairs) treats partial generalizations, but the general non-nested and disjoint-support cases remain without a complete asymptotic theory, as the loss of the three-term recurrence and absence of algebraic relations for the Sobolev product obstruct standard techniques. No source found resolving the disjoint or non-nested support cases in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics for Jacobi–Sobolev orthogonal polynomials associated with non-coherent pairs of measures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies asymptotics where pairs of measures are not coherent, with supports as intervals on the real line.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists for non-coherent pairs but general non-nested cases are not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: On Sobolev orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: In the Sobolev setting, the multiplication operator is no longer symmetric and the three-term relation fails, depriving the theory of a fundamental tool.
status_evidence.claim: Loss of three-term recurrence is the key obstacle in extending asymptotic results.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics for Gegenbauer–Sobolev orthogonal polynomials associated with non-coherent pairs
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic behaviour for non-coherent symmetric pairs of measures.
status_evidence.claim: Only specific non-coherent symmetric configurations have been treated.
